[ THE PROBLEM ]

TURN VIDEO INTO AWARENESS.

A camera records pixels; a useful security system needs to interpret who is present. This project explores the complete path from a live frame to an identity match.

The focus is practical recognition: detecting faces reliably, representing them numerically, comparing them with known identities, and returning a visible result in real time.

[ HOW IT WORKS ]

FRAME TO IDENTITY.

01 / CAPTURE

READ VIDEO

OpenCV streams frames from the connected camera.

02 / DETECT

LOCATE FACES

The vision pipeline finds valid face regions inside each frame.

03 / EMBED

ENCODE IDENTITY

InsightFace converts facial features into comparable embeddings.

04 / MATCH

IDENTIFY VISITORS

Embeddings are compared with known records and the result is overlaid live.

[ ENGINEERING ]

KEY CONSIDERATIONS.

01

REAL-TIME LATENCY

02

Similarity thresholds balance false matches against missed identities.

03
